closed.message: The integration is reloading. Try again in a moment.

no_answer.message: The amp didn't answer. Check that it's powered on, the cable is connected, and the rear switch is set to MASTER.

port_failed.message: The serial port stopped working. The integration is reconnecting.

port_in_use.message: The port is in use. If the built-in Monoprice integration is set up, delete it first.

port_not_found.message: The port doesn't exist. Check that the USB adapter is plugged in.

unknown_source.message: {source} isn't one of the named sources.
